MCP servers

Tools from other programs, offered to the DOCA harness while their server runs.

+ ADD SERVER
Model Context Protocol servers. A running server's tools are offered to the DOCA harness alongside its built-in ones, named mcp__server__tool, and each can be switched off in the harness ⚙ panel. Only running servers contribute tools, and nothing is started unless you say so. Servers are grouped by the machine they act on: this host, or a paired client — and once a client is in play the harness is told which machine each tool reaches, so you can ask for something "on my PC" and get the right one.
